kazaVerse: “My Lord! Make me and my descendants steadfast in prayer.”
goalHint: Enter your total qada prayer goal in days.
selectBirthHint: 👆 Select your birth date to auto-calculate your debt.
approxNote: This calculation is approximate. Fractions have been rounded.

quran.title: Search a surah
quran.body: Search a surah by name or number: typing “baqarah” or “2” is enough. Accents and apostrophes don't break it.

prayer.title: Mark your prayer
prayer.body: Tap the prayer you completed. Days with all five build a streak.

qada.title: Missed-prayer counters
qada.body: Keep a separate count for each prayer. Use plus and minus to update.

murakabe.title: Daily reckoning
murakabe.body: Short questions you ask yourself at the end of the day. Your answers tip the scale toward soul or ego.

openSurah.title: Tap a surah
openSurah.body: Tapping a card opens the surah. Inside you can switch the reading mode and jump to any verse.
